findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: github_repo_activity · Private data: dnsdomain, npm_downloads_range, who_gho_indicator_timeseries, doaj_article_search, stablecoin_supply, polymarket_trades, registry_watch · Public sink: dnsdomain, npm_downloads_range, who_gho_indicator_timeseries, doaj_article_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: github_repo_activity · Private data: dnsdomain, npm_downloads_range, who_gho_indicator_timeseries, doaj_article_search, stablecoin_supply, polymarket_trades, registry_watch · Public sink: dnsdomain, npm_downloads_range, who_gho_indicator_timeseries, doaj_article_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
